definitions.explanation: A strong feeling of dislike or repulsion toward something or someone. Stronger than simple dislike.

examples.japanese: ⟦{暴力|ぼうりょく}→暴力：02528_bouryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{嫌悪|けんお}する。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{嫌悪感|けんおかん}→嫌悪感：15749_kenokan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|いだ}いた→抱く：02010_idaku⟧。
examples.english: I felt disgust at his attitude.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自己|じこ}→自己：23357_jiko⟧{嫌悪|けんお}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥|おちい}る→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦{差別|さべつ}→差別：01633_sabetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対|たい}する→対する：02126_taisuru⟧⟦{嫌悪感|けんおかん}→嫌悪感：15749_kenokan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{年々|ねんねん}→年々：10417_nennen⟧⟦{強|つよ}まっている→強まる：02295_tsuyomaru⟧。
examples.english: The aversion toward discrimination has been growing stronger year by year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{失敗|しっぱい}した→失敗する：01636_shippai⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{嫌|いや}で→嫌：10232_iya⟧、⟦{自己|じこ}→自己：23357_jiko⟧{嫌悪|けんお}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{苦|くる}しんだ→苦しむ：01938_kurushimu⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There was a period when I hated myself for failing and suffered from self-loathing.

notes:
{嫌悪|けんお} expresses strong dislike or revulsion — much stronger than ⟦{嫌|きら}い→嫌い：02871_kirai⟧. It belongs to a formal or literary register and is common in written Japanese, news, and psychology.

FORMS:
{嫌|けん} (dislike) + {悪|お} (bad, loathe)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{嫌悪感|けんおかん}→嫌悪感：15749_kenokan⟧: feeling of disgust
- ⟦{嫌悪感|けんおかん}→嫌悪感：15749_kenokan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|いだ}く→抱く：02010_idaku⟧: to harbor disgust
- ⟦{自己|じこ}→自己：23357_jiko⟧{嫌悪|けんお}: self-loathing
- {嫌悪|けんお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧: to show aversion

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{嫌|きら}い→嫌い：02871_kirai⟧: dislike (casual, everyday)
- {嫌悪|けんお}: loathing (formal, stronger)
- ⟦{憎|にく}しみ→憎しみ：15769_nikushimi⟧: hatred (personal, emotional)
- ⟦{軽蔑|けいべつ}→軽蔑：04849_keibetsu⟧: contempt (looking down on someone)
